item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
Issued at 04:43 AM 24 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Iloilo(Carles, Estancia, Balasan, Batad, Sara), #Capiz(RoxasCity, Ivisan, Sigma and Dao) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Capiz(Panay, Pontevedra, PresidentRoxas, Pilar, MaAyon, Panitan), #NegrosOccidental(CadizCity, Manapla), #Aklan(Malinao, Banga, Balete, Madalag), #EasternSamar(Sulat, Taft, CanAvid, Maslog, Dolores), #Samar(SanJoseDeBuan, Paranas and Hinabangan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
